name: c4x
description: Capture the Claude Code context window into a local SQLite store, and read it back

no-dependencies: ONE devDependency, and it took a deliberate decision to add it. Everything that RUNS here
still needs nothing: every tool uses node built-ins alone, node:sqlite included, so installing
this extension pulls nothing and a clone can harvest and read its store with an empty
node_modules. That property is intact and worth keeping.
What changed is the LINTER, which is not part of what runs. It was invoked as
`npx --yes eslint .`, which resolves whatever is newest at the moment CI happens to run, so a
release could change what lints between two runs of the same commit. A pinned devDependency
and a committed lockfile make that reproducible. The cost is a root node_modules for anyone
who wants to lint, and `npm ci` in CI; the cost is not paid by anyone who only wants to use
The Python side is requirements.txt for what runs, requirements-dev.txt for the checks, and
constraints-ci.txt for the exact versions CI resolves.
